pages.title: How it started
pages.text: This mod is an addon for $(l)Create$().$(br)Adventure packs often ship with $(l)Create$(),$(br)yet needing a whole machine just for a couple of items gets in the way.$(br)So this mod happened.

pages.title: A few rules we kept
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Never touch Create's machines.$()Whatever the hand tools do, machines must not be affected — that is what the three-layer recipe system is for.$(br2)$(li)$(l)Data first.$()What a tool can do is decided by datapacks and KubeJS, i.e. by modpack authors.$(br2)$(li)$(l)Rather nothing than half of it.$()Anything uncertain stays out of this book.$(br2)Bugs and ideas: open an issue on the repository.
